title: Narrative Ambiguity Matters
title_zh: 叙事模糊性的重要性
title_primary: 叙事模糊性的重要性
title_secondary: Narrative Ambiguity Matters
authors: Xinbei Wei, Qunzi Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-09-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: By extracting information from economic news articles, this paper proposes a novel measure of narrative-based ambiguity that captures investors’ attitudes toward narrative uncertainty and exhibits strong in- and out-of-sample predictive power for the stock market returns. It reveals general ambiguity aversion except in high loss probability scenarios in which ambiguity tolerance emerges. Further tests confirm the significant pricing power and distinct information of the narrative ambiguity on top of existing ambiguity measures, such as survey- and return-based ambiguity. By aligning industry-specific narrative ambiguity, we construct a superior predictor for market returns with the predictability predominantly driven by the ambiguity from consumption-, energy-, and technology-related sectors. Our findings also carry broad implications as the predictability remains significant across international markets and other asset classes. This paper has been accepted by Will Cong for the Virtual Special Issue on Digital Finance. Funding: Q. Zhang acknowledges research support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72573098], the National Natural Science Foundation of China Excellent Young Researcher Project [Grant 72222013], and the National Key R&D Program of China [Grant 2023YFA1009200]. X. Wei acknowledges research support from the Capital University of Economics and Business Scientific Research Project [Grant XRZ2025010]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02735 .
abstract_zh: 本文通过从经济新闻文章中提取信息，提出了一种基于叙事的新颖不确定性度量方法，该方法捕捉了投资者对叙事不确定性的态度，并对股票市场回报展现出强大的样本内和样本外预测能力。研究揭示了普遍的不确定性规避现象，但在高损失概率情境下则表现出不确定性容忍。进一步测试证实，在现有不确定性度量（如基于调查和基于回报的不确定性）之上，叙事不确定性具有显著的定价能力和独特信息。通过整合行业特定的叙事不确定性，我们构建了一个更优的市场回报预测指标，其预测能力主要由消费、能源和技术相关行业的不确定性驱动。我们的发现还具有广泛意义，因为这种预测能力在国际市场和其他资产类别中依然显著。本文已被Will Cong接受，用于数字金融虚拟特刊。资助：Q. title: How Monetary Policy Is Made: Lessons from Historical FOMC Discussions
title_zh: 货币政策是如何制定的：历史FOMC讨论的启示
title_primary: 货币政策是如何制定的：历史FOMC讨论的启示
title_secondary: How Monetary Policy Is Made: Lessons from Historical FOMC Discussions
authors: Cooper Howes, Marc Dordal i Carreras, Olivier Coibion, Yuriy Gorodnichenko
official: 官方在线 2025-12-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We construct a new dataset of FOMC meeting transcripts from 1966 to 1990 to analyze the sources of heterogeneity in individual monetary policy preferences and study how this heterogeneity shapes policy decisions. Using these detailed discussions, we manually quantify and characterize each FOMC participants’ preferred policies along with their reasoning and justification. We show that participants' beliefs about the effects of monetary policy—specifically, their perceived slope of the Phillips Curve—play a central role. Participants who believe monetary policy has stronger effects on real activity are more likely to cite output as a justification for easing, while those perceiving stronger price effects emphasize inflation as a reason for tightening. We then show that the Chair plays a unique and powerful role in reconciling these views, not just in setting policy rates, but also in minimizing dissent. The latter occurs because dissenters find their ability to influence policy in subsequent meetings is significantly curtailed.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个涵盖1966年至1990年联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）会议记录的新数据集，以分析个体货币政策偏好的异质性来源，并研究这种异质性如何影响政策决策。利用这些详尽的讨论内容，我们手动量化并刻画了每位FOMC参与者的偏好政策及其理由和论证。研究表明，参与者对货币政策效果的信念——特别是他们对菲利普斯曲线斜率的感知——起着核心作用。认为货币政策对实际经济活动影响更强的参与者，更倾向于将产出作为宽松政策的理由；而那些感知价格效应更强的参与者，则强调通胀作为紧缩政策的依据。随后，我们指出，主席在调和这些观点中扮演着独特且强有力的角色，不仅体现在设定政策利率上，还体现在最小化异议方面。后者之所以发生，是因为持异议者在后续会议中影响政策的能力显著受限。

title: Irreversible investment in divided times: Complementarity and public good provision
title_zh: 分裂时期的不可逆投资：互补性与公共品供给
title_primary: 分裂时期的不可逆投资：互补性与公共品供给
title_secondary: Irreversible investment in divided times: Complementarity and public good provision
authors: Ying Chen, Liuchun Deng, Minako Fujio, M. Ali Khan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study technology investment and public good provision in a setting where two parties with differing valuations of the public good alternate in power. In each period, the incumbent chooses public good provision and invests in technology that lowers the cost of future public good provision. We characterize Markov perfect equilibria and show how polarization and irreversibility of investment jointly shape long-run outcomes. When polarization is low, power turnover may increase expected technology investment and public good provision, and steady-state outcomes are unaffected by the degree of reversibility. When polarization is high, however, irreversibility becomes important: the party favoring the public good invests more aggressively, and irreversible investment induces higher public good provision by both parties. As polarization rises, expected technology stock and public good provision initially decline but jump upward once the irreversibility constraint binds.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在一个两方对公共产品估值不同的环境中，技术投资与公共产品供给的问题。每一时期，执政方选择公共产品供给，并投资于能降低未来公共产品供给成本的技术。我们刻画了马尔可夫完美均衡，并展示了极化程度与投资不可逆性如何共同塑造长期结果。当极化程度较低时，权力更迭可能增加预期的技术投资和公共产品供给，且稳态结果不受可逆性程度的影响。然而，当极化程度较高时，不可逆性变得重要：偏好公共产品的一方会更积极地进行投资，且不可逆投资促使双方提高公共产品供给。随着极化程度上升，预期的技术存量与公共产品供给起初下降，但一旦不可逆性约束生效，则会向上跳跃。

title: Idle monetary policy? Evidence from monetary policy shocks for Pakistan
title_zh: 闲置的货币政策？来自巴基斯坦货币政策冲击的证据
title_primary: 闲置的货币政策？来自巴基斯坦货币政策冲击的证据
title_secondary: Idle monetary policy? Evidence from monetary policy shocks for Pakistan
authors: M. Ali Choudhary, Vasco J. Gabriel
official: 官方在线 2026-09-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We challenge the narrative of idle monetary transmission in Pakistan. By cleansing conventional policy measures of anticipatory and endogenous motives à la Romer and Romer (2004), and using local projections in long differences (Jordá and Taylor, 2025; Piger and Stockwell, 2025), Piger and Stockwell, 2025], we trace the effects of monetary shocks on macroeconomic and financial outcomes while controlling for the global financial cycle (Miranda-Agrippino and Rey, 2020). A contractionary shock generates a large and persistent output contraction and a significant, non-monotone response of year-on-year inflation, with disinflation on impact and again after eight to nine quarters. The policy rate rises in the short run, while term-spread and credit responses are economically coherent but less precisely estimated. US monetary spillovers are small and statistically imprecise. Monetary policy works in Pakistan; only its measurement was idle.
abstract_zh: 我们挑战了关于巴基斯坦货币政策传导失效的叙事。通过借鉴Romer和Romer（2004）的方法，剔除常规政策度量中的预期性和内生性动机，并采用长期差分中的局部投影法（Jordá和Taylor，2025；Piger和Stockwell，2025），我们在控制全球金融周期（Miranda-Agrippino和Rey，2020）的同时，追踪了货币冲击对宏观经济和金融结果的影响。一个紧缩性冲击会导致产出大幅且持久的收缩，以及同比通胀显著的非单调反应，表现为即时通缩效应及在八至九个季度后再次出现的通缩。政策利率在短期内上升，而期限利差和信贷反应在经济上具有一致性，但估计精度较低。美国货币溢出效应较小且统计上不显著。货币政策在巴基斯坦是有效的；只是其度量方式此前一直处于停滞状态。

title: Associative Networks in Decision Making
title_zh: 决策中的联想网络
title_primary: 决策中的联想网络
title_secondary: Associative Networks in Decision Making
authors: Li, Jiangtao, Tang, Rui, Zhang, Mu
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We present a model of associative networks that captures how decision makers expand their consideration set through mental associations between alternatives. Our model provides a tractable approach to study how associations shape choice when some alternatives are available and others are merely observable but unavailable. We characterize the model within a random attention framework and demonstrate unique identification of all parameters. This framework delivers a unified account of several prominent choice anomalies, including classic menu effects and their “phantom” counterparts. We illustrate how associative links serve as a strategic variable in applications such as branding, imitation, and platform design.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个联想网络模型，用以刻画决策者如何通过备选方案之间的心理联想来扩展其考虑集。该模型提供了一种可操作的方法，用于研究当某些备选方案可用而其他方案仅可观察但不可获得时，联想如何塑造选择行为。我们在随机注意力框架内对该模型进行刻画，并证明所有参数均可唯一识别。此框架统一解释了若干显著的选择异常现象，包括经典菜单效应及其“幻影”对应物。我们进一步说明，在品牌塑造、模仿和平台设计等应用中，联想链接如何作为策略性变量发挥作用。

title: Simultaneous prediction of multiple dimensions of food security
title_zh: 粮食安全多维度同步预测
title_primary: 粮食安全多维度同步预测
title_secondary: Simultaneous prediction of multiple dimensions of food security
authors: Salima Bekbolotova, Nodir Djanibekov, Thomas Herzfeld, Lucie Maruejols
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Program officers are faced with difficult modeling choices when monitoring the state of diverse yet related dimensions of household food security. We compare results of single- and multi-output frameworks, applying both econometric and machine learning models, to jointly predict three interrelated outcomes of food security: undernourishment (access), dietary diversity (utilization), and food consumption stability (stability). Using the 2013–2022 Kyrgyz Integrated Household Survey, we evaluate generalized linear models (GLM), a multi-output generalized structural equation model (GSEM), and single- and multi-output artificial neural networks (ANNs) under both cross-sectional and temporal validation settings. The results show that accounting for non-linearity of relationships in our specifications yields greater predictive gains than modeling outcomes jointly. Among the models evaluated, the simplest model (single outcome GLM) often performs as well as others, and even better in some specifications, while also providing interpretable parameter estimates. However, accounting for non-linearity with our single-outcome ANN often achieves superior performance in low-outcome groups, which is especially relevant for policies aimed at targeting vulnerable households. Adding complexity through joint prediction of the related outcomes improves precision in some cases, but reduces recall, increasing exclusion risk. This trade-off makes such approach less desirable from both equity and implementation perspectives. The findings emphasize that complex patterns tie household socio-economic and demographic characteristics with food security dimensions. These results can guide program officers navigating the trade-offs between prediction performance, interpretability, and implementation; showing that linear models can deliver robust predictions, but specific non-linear, data-driven models might allow better targeting of vulnerable households.
abstract_zh: 项目官员在监测家庭粮食安全中多样但相互关联的维度时，面临着困难的建模选择。我们比较了单一输出与多输出框架的结果，应用计量经济学和机器学习模型，共同预测粮食安全的三个相互关联的结果：营养不足（获取）、膳食多样性（利用）和食品消费稳定性（稳定性）。利用2013-2022年吉尔吉斯斯坦综合家庭调查数据，我们在横截面和时间验证设置下评估了广义线性模型（GLM）、多输出广义结构方程模型（GSEM）以及单一和多输出人工神经网络（ANNs）。结果表明，在我们的设定中考虑关系的非线性比联合建模结果能带来更大的预测增益。在评估的模型中，最简单的模型（单一输出GLM）通常表现与其他模型相当，在某些设定中甚至更好，同时提供可解释的参数估计。然而，使用单一输出ANN考虑非线性在低结果组中往往实现更优性能，这对于旨在瞄准脆弱家庭的政策尤为重要。通过联合预测相关结果增加复杂性在某些情况下提高了精确度，但降低了召回率，增加了排除风险。这种权衡使得该方法在公平性和实施性方面都不太可取。研究结果强调，复杂的模式将家庭社会经济和人口特征与粮食安全维度紧密相连。这些结果可以指导项目官员在预测性能、可解释性和实施之间进行权衡；表明线性模型可以提供稳健的预测，但特定的非线性、数据驱动模型可能更好地瞄准脆弱家庭。

title: Aging Economies and AI Adoption: Firm-Level Evidence from the World Bank Enterprise Surveys
title_zh: 老龄化经济体与人工智能采纳：来自世界银行企业调查的企业层面证据
title_primary: 老龄化经济体与人工智能采纳：来自世界银行企业调查的企业层面证据
title_secondary: Aging Economies and AI Adoption: Firm-Level Evidence from the World Bank Enterprise Surveys
authors: Ha Minh Nguyen
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: How do demographic trends shape the adoption of AI and automation technologies? This paper provides the first large-scale cross-country firm-level test of the demographic–automation hypothesis using World Bank Enterprise Surveys data covering 89,380 firms across 144 countries from 2022 to 2025. I classify adopters by applying a large language model to firms’ open-ended process innovation descriptions, identifying 1,656 AI and automation adopters (1.9 percent of the sample). A ten-percentage-point increase in the old-age dependency ratio raises process adoption probability by approximately 0.6 percentage points, after accounting for countries’ income levels, digital infrastructure, firm size and sector, and broad regional and time differences. The result is robust across specifications and supported by an instrumental variable strategy based on predetermined demographic cohort structure. Heterogeneity analysis shows the effect concentrates in manufacturing, large firms, and developing economies for the broad adoption measure; restricting to firms with explicit references to AI reverses the sector pattern, with services firms significantly more likely to adopt than manufacturing firms, pointing to distinct sectoral profiles for software-based AI and hardware-based automation. Aging also predicts firms’ development of AI-enabled products across both manufacturing and services. The results indicate that demographic aging shapes AI and automation adoption through both process and product innovation channels: firms substitute technology for increasingly scarce and costly labor in production, and separately develop AI-enabled products for labor-constrained customers.
abstract_zh: 人口结构趋势如何影响人工智能与自动化技术的采用？本文利用世界银行企业调查数据，覆盖2022至2025年间144个国家的89，380家企业，首次进行了大规模跨国企业层面的“人口结构—自动化”假说检验。我通过将大语言模型应用于企业对开放式流程创新描述的分类，识别出1，656家人工智能与自动化采用者（占样本的1.9%）。在控制国家收入水平、数字基础设施、企业规模与行业以及广泛的区域和时间差异后，老年抚养比每上升十个百分点，流程采用概率约提高0.6个百分点。该结果在多种设定下保持稳健，并得到基于预定人口队列结构的工具变量策略的支持。异质性分析表明，在广义采用指标下，效应集中于制造业、大型企业和发展中经济体；而将样本限制为明确提及人工智能的企业后，行业模式发生逆转，服务业企业显著比制造业企业更可能采用，这揭示了基于软件的人工智能与基于硬件的自动化具有不同的行业特征。人口老龄化同样预测了制造业和服务业中企业开发人工智能赋能产品的行为。结果表明，人口老龄化通过流程创新和产品创新两条渠道塑造人工智能与自动化的采用：企业以技术替代生产中日益稀缺和昂贵的劳动力，并同时为面临劳动力约束的客户开发人工智能赋能产品。

title: Low-carbon policy regulation and spatial effects: evidence from China
title_zh: 低碳政策规制与空间效应：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 低碳政策规制与空间效应：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Low-carbon policy regulation and spatial effects: evidence from China
authors: Yulin Zhu, Minzhi Sun
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines the spatial treatment effects of Low-carbon City pilot policy on PM 2.5 concentrations across 277 cities in China from 2005 to 2023. Based on spatial causal inference, this study finds that this policy significantly decreases PM 2.5 concentrations in regions with greater policy intensity, while the direct effects of this policy are not significant in regions with lower policy intensity. Furthermore, the implementation of this policy reduces PM 2.5 concentrations in the neighbouring cities from the perspective of spatial effects while its direct effects are weaker. The implementation of Low-carbon City pilot policy diminishes PM 2.5 concentrations through increasing environmental technological innovation capacity and average green asset ratio of regional firms. This study further examines the spatial attenuation effects and heterogeneous impacts arising from differentiated policy regulation intensity, indicating the transformation of the spatial pattern from mutual collaboration to a beggar-thy-neighbour situation as distance increases. KEYWORDS: Environmental pilot policy spatial causal inference spillover effects spatial attenuation effects JEL CLASSIFICATION: C31 Q55 Q56 Acknowledgements The authors gratefully thank editors and three anonymous referees for their insightful feedback.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了低碳城市试点政策对2005年至2023年间中国277个城市PM 2.5浓度的空间处理效应。基于空间因果推断，本研究发现该政策在政策强度较高的地区显著降低了PM 2.5浓度，而在政策强度较低的地区，其直接效应并不显著。此外，从空间效应的角度来看，该政策的实施降低了邻近城市的PM 2.5浓度，而其直接效应则相对较弱。低碳城市试点政策的实施通过提升区域企业的环境技术创新能力和平均绿色资产比率来降低PM 2.5浓度。本研究进一步探讨了差异化政策调控强度所带来的空间衰减效应和异质性影响，表明随着距离的增加，空间格局从相互协作转变为以邻为壑的状态。关键词：环境试点政策 空间因果推断 溢出效应 空间衰减效应 JEL分类：C31 Q55 Q56 致谢 作者衷心感谢编辑及三位匿名审稿人的 insightful 反馈意见。

title: Contested Transparency: Digital Monitoring Technologies and Worker Voice
title_zh: 争议中的透明度：数字监控技术与工人话语权
title_primary: 争议中的透明度：数字监控技术与工人话语权
title_secondary: Contested Transparency: Digital Monitoring Technologies and Worker Voice
authors: Gabriel Burdin, Stefano Dughera, Fabio Landini, Filippo Belloc
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Advances in artificial intelligence and data analytics have notably expanded employers’ monitoring and surveillance capabilities. While new digital monitoring (DM) technologies facilitate the accurate observability of work effort, their productivity and broader welfare implications remain subject to debate. In this context, many countries confer information, consultation and co-determination rights to employee representation (ER) bodies on matters related to workplace organization and the introduction of new technologies, which could potentially discourage employers from making DM investments. Using a cross-sectional sample of more than 21,000 European establishments, we find instead that establishments with ER are more likely to utilize DM technologies than establishments without ER. We also document a positive effect of ER on DM utilization in the context of a local-randomization regression discontinuity analysis that exploits size-contingent policy rules governing the operation of ER bodies in Europe. We rationalize this unexpected finding through the lens of a theoretical model in which shared governance via ER creates organizational safeguards that mitigate workers’ control-averse responses to monitoring.
abstract_zh: 人工智能与数据分析技术的进步显著扩展了雇主的监控与监督能力。尽管新型数字监控（DM）技术有助于精确观测工作投入，但其生产率及更广泛的福利影响仍存争议。在此背景下，许多国家赋予员工代表（ER）机构在工作场所组织及新技术引入相关事务上的知情权、协商权与共同决策权，这可能抑制雇主进行DM投资。基于对超过21,000家欧洲企业的横截面样本，我们发现，与无ER机构的企业相比，设有ER机构的企业更倾向于采用DM技术。我们还利用欧洲ER机构运作中基于规模的政策规则，通过局部随机化回归断点分析，记录了ER对DM利用的积极影响。我们通过一个理论模型来解释这一意外发现，该模型认为，经由ER实现的共同治理创造了组织保障机制，从而缓解了员工对监控的抵触反应。

title: Ecological impacts and countermeasures for future solar photovoltaic expansion: Based on the assessment and planning of ecosystem services
title_zh: 未来太阳能光伏扩张的生态影响与应对措施：基于生态系统服务的评估与规划
title_primary: 未来太阳能光伏扩张的生态影响与应对措施：基于生态系统服务的评估与规划
title_secondary: Ecological impacts and countermeasures for future solar photovoltaic expansion: Based on the assessment and planning of ecosystem services
authors: Ruijing Wang, Jirui Gong, Guisen Yang, Shangpeng Zhang, Tong Wang 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The accelerated development of solar photovoltaic (PV) is crucial for achieving global climate goals, yet it poses significant ecological challenges due to the extensive land occupation. The “PV + ” land use model could be a countermeasure. By quantifying the ecological cost of multiple PV expansion scenarios in China and the potential ecological compensation capacity of “PV + ” model, we present an optimized energy expansion pathway. From the perspective of ecosystem services, we found that historical PV expansion caused an ecological loss of $2.15 billion (0.78 USD/m2). Without energy pathway optimization, the accelerated expansion required to meet 2050 targets would lead to ecological losses of $18.56 to $37.11 billion. However, pathway optimization can reduce those losses by 58–81%. Our analysis based on field investigations revealed that the "PV + " system holds significant potential for ecological compensation. Agriculture–PV has the highest capacity (0.63 USD/m2), even exceeding the pre-construction value of cropland, while Grassland–PV and Gobi and Desert-PV also achieve ecological restoration. Prioritizing the development of suitable land or barren land is the optimal expansion path to achieve a triple-win situation in energy, economics, and ecology. The power generation capacity of these pathways could reach 7.21–19.75 PWh annually by 2050, while reducing ecological costs to 0.09–0.19 USD/m2. This study provides guidance for ecologically considerate PV expansion planning and supports the sustainable management of PV power plants, offering a replicable solution for optimizing global renewable energy expansion.
abstract_zh: 太阳能光伏（PV）的加速发展对于实现全球气候目标至关重要，然而由于大量土地占用，它也带来了显著的生态挑战。“光伏+”土地利用模式或可成为应对之策。通过量化中国多种光伏扩张情景下的生态成本及“光伏+”模式的潜在生态补偿能力，我们提出了一条优化的能源扩张路径。从生态系统服务的角度来看，我们发现历史光伏扩张已造成21.5亿美元（0.78美元/平方米）的生态损失。若不对能源路径进行优化，为满足2050年目标所需的加速扩张将导致185.6亿至371.1亿美元的生态损失。然而，路径优化可将这些损失减少58%至81%。基于实地调查的分析表明，“光伏+”系统具有显著的生态补偿潜力。农业-光伏模式的补偿能力最高（0.63美元/平方米），甚至超过了农田建设前的价值，而草地-光伏和戈壁沙漠-光伏模式同样实现了生态修复。优先开发适宜土地或荒芜土地是实现能源、经济和生态三方共赢的最优扩张路径。到2050年，这些路径的发电能力可达每年7.21至19.75拍瓦时，同时将生态成本降至0.09至0.19美元/平方米。本研究为兼顾生态考量的光伏扩张规划提供了指导，并支持光伏电站的可持续管理，为优化全球可再生能源扩张提供了可复制的解决方案。

authors: Bernardus Van Doornik, Dimas Fazio, Tarun Ramadorai, Jānis Skrastiņš
official: 官方在线 2024-12-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines the impact of access to housing on fertility rates using random variation from housing credit lotteries in Brazil. We find that obtaining housing increases the average probability of having a child by 3.8% and the number of children by 3.2%. For 20 to 25-year-olds, the corresponding effects are 32% and 33%, with no increase in fertility for people above age 40. The lifetime fertility increase for a 20-year old is twice as large from obtaining housing immediately relative to obtaining it at age 30. The increase in fertility is stronger for households in areas with lower quality housing, greater rental expenses relative to income, and those with lower household income and lower female income share. These results suggest that alleviating housing credit and physical space constraints can significantly increase fertility.
abstract_zh: 本文利用巴西住房信贷抽签产生的随机变动，考察了获得住房对生育率的影响。我们发现，获得住房使平均生育概率提高3.8%，子女数量增加3.2%。对于20至25岁的人群，相应效应分别为32%和33%，而40岁以上人群的生育率未见增长。对于20岁个体而言，立即获得住房相较于30岁时获得，其终身生育率增幅是后者的两倍。生育率的提升在住房质量较低、租金占收入比例较高、家庭收入较低及女性收入份额较低的地区更为显著。这些结果表明，缓解住房信贷和物理空间约束能显著促进生育率。

abstract: This study examines the impact of clean production on export product quality by focusing on a key whole-process environmental regulation policy in China. Using a difference-in-differences approach and firm-level microdata, we find that the policy significantly improves export product quality and can explain 3.3% of the one standard deviation change in the export product quality of firms covered by the policy. Mechanism analysis shows that the policy functions through three interconnected channels: factor reallocation in source prevention, innovation compensation in production processes, and product transformation in end-of-pipe treatment. Additional analysis reveals stronger positive impacts on non-state-owned firms, large firms, and firms located in regions with high environmental regulation intensity. This study highlights the significant environmental and economic benefits of shifting from end-of-pipe pollution control to process control in production. abstract_zh: 本研究聚焦于中国一项关键的全过程环境规制政策，探讨清洁生产对出口产品质量的影响。采用双重差分法与企业层面微观数据，我们发现该政策显著提升了出口产品质量，并能解释受政策覆盖企业出口产品质量一个标准差变动的3.3%。机制分析表明，该政策通过三个相互关联的渠道发挥作用：源头预防中的要素重新配置、生产过程中的创新补偿以及末端治理中的产品转型。进一步分析显示，该政策对非国有企业、大型企业以及位于环境规制强度较高地区的企业具有更强的正向影响。本研究凸显了从末端污染控制转向生产过程控制所带来的显著环境与经济效益。关键词：清洁生产；环境规制；产品质量；末端治理；JEL分类：F10 F12 F18 致谢：我们感谢意得辑（www.editage.cn）提供的英文语言编辑服务。所有作者均对本研究做出了重要贡献。材料准备、数据收集与分析由陶林和明晓清完成。论文初稿由明晓清、陶林和刘贝利撰写，所有作者对先前版本的手稿提出了意见。

title: Demand for Safety in the Crypto Ecosystem
title_zh: 加密生态系统中的安全需求
title_primary: 加密生态系统中的安全需求
title_secondary: Demand for Safety in the Crypto Ecosystem
authors: Murillo Campello, Angela Gallo, Lira Mota, Tammaro Terracciano
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the demand for safety and liquidity in the crypto ecosystem. We do so under a framework in which a representative investor allocates liquidity across stablecoin deposits in lending pools and traditional safe assets (e.g., MMF shares). Our model delivers three main predictions: (i) the stablecoin deposit premium co-moves with the Treasury premium when investors value the safety and liquidity services of stablecoins; (ii) increases in Treasury supply reduce the stablecoin deposit premium; and (iii) drops in the perceived safety and liquidity of stablecoin deposits (e.g., due to de-pegs or hacker attacks) reduce their premium. Using granular data from hundreds of DeFi pools spanning multiple protocols, tokens, and blockchains, we find evidence supporting these predictions. Investors treat stablecoin deposits as money-like instruments that are borderless and permissionless, yet as fragile as other forms of privately produced safe assets.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了加密生态系统中对安全性和流动性的需求。我们在一个代表性投资者在借贷池中的稳定币存款与传统安全资产（如货币市场基金份额）之间分配流动性的框架下进行分析。我们的模型提出了三个主要预测：（i）当投资者重视稳定币的安全性和流动性服务时，稳定币存款溢价与国债溢价共同变动；（ii）国债供给的增加会降低稳定币存款溢价；（iii）稳定币存款感知安全性和流动性的下降（例如，由于脱钩或黑客攻击）会减少其溢价。利用涵盖多个协议、代币和区块链的数百个DeFi池的细粒度数据，我们找到了支持这些预测的证据。投资者将稳定币存款视为无国界、无需许可的货币类工具，但同时也像其他形式的私人生产的安全资产一样脆弱。

title: Comparing participatory and expert‑led decisions: Insights from participatory planning of nature‑based solutions for advancing land degradation neutrality in northern Tanzania
title_zh: 比较参与式与专家主导决策：坦桑尼亚北部推进土地退化零增长的自然解决方案参与式规划启示
title_primary: 比较参与式与专家主导决策：坦桑尼亚北部推进土地退化零增长的自然解决方案参与式规划启示
title_secondary: Comparing participatory and expert‑led decisions: Insights from participatory planning of nature‑based solutions for advancing land degradation neutrality in northern Tanzania
authors: Cynthia Nneka Olumba, R. J. Rickson, Anna Rabinovich, Jeremy Lind, Kelvin Mtei 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Nature-based Solutions (NbS) are promoted as effective strategies to address agricultural land degradation and advance Land Degradation Neutrality (LDN). However, identifying context-appropriate NbS remains challenging due to socio-ecological trade-offs and diverse stakeholder priorities. This study empirically tests an integrated Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA) and Social Choice Theory (SCT) framework for participatory NbS prioritisation. Data were collected through a multi-stakeholder workshop in northern Tanzania involving 31 purposively sampled participants across four stakeholder groups: farmers/agropastoralists, NGOs, local authorities, and agricultural professionals. Descriptive analysis was used to examine how stakeholder groups prioritised NbS decision criteria. NbS alternatives were evaluated using the Weighted Sum Model within MCDA, combined with SCT’s k-approval method, to identify the three most context-appropriate options. Participatory and expert-driven outcomes were compared using correlation and rank-agreement analysis, and robustness was assessed through scenario-based sensitivity analysis. Results show broad stakeholder consensus in prioritising environmental restoration functions of NbS, particularly soil erosion control, alongside stakeholder-specific differences in the prioritisation of other criteria. The integrated framework identified contour planting, cover cropping, and agroforestry as the highest-ranked NbS options. Incorporating SCT altered the final ordering of alternatives, demonstrating its influence on decision outcomes. Findings further showed that participatory and expert-driven outcomes diverged, indicating that stakeholder inclusion can materially influence prioritisation outcomes, beyond procedural benefits. Sensitivity analysis confirmed that rankings were robust under varying weighting scenarios. Overall, the study advances NbS and LDN research by demonstrating how participatory decision-support frameworks can support the selection of context‑appropriate and socially legitimate NbS to advance LDN.
abstract_zh: 基于自然的解决方案（NbS）被视为应对农业土地退化并推进土地退化零增长（LDN）的有效策略。然而，由于社会生态权衡和利益相关者优先事项的多样性，识别符合情境的NbS仍具挑战性。本研究实证检验了一个整合多准则决策分析（MCDA）与社会选择理论（SCT）的框架，用于参与式NbS优先级排序。数据通过坦桑尼亚北部的一次多方利益相关者研讨会收集，涉及31名有目的抽样的参与者，涵盖四个利益相关者群体：农民/农牧民、非政府组织、地方政府和农业专业人员。采用描述性分析考察各利益相关者群体如何对NbS决策准则进行优先级排序。NbS备选方案通过MCDA中的加权求和模型进行评估，并结合SCT的k-approval方法，以识别三个最符合情境的选项。参与式结果与专家驱动结果通过相关性和排名一致性分析进行比较，并通过基于情景的敏感性分析评估稳健性。结果显示，利益相关者在优先考虑NbS的环境恢复功能（尤其是土壤侵蚀控制）方面存在广泛共识，同时在其他准则的优先级排序上存在群体间差异。整合框架识别出等高种植、覆盖作物和农林业为排名最高的NbS选项。纳入SCT改变了备选方案的最终排序，表明其对决策结果具有影响。研究进一步发现，参与式结果与专家驱动结果存在分歧，表明利益相关者的纳入可能实质性影响优先级排序结果，而不仅仅是程序性收益。敏感性分析确认，在不同权重情景下排名保持稳健。总体而言，本研究通过展示参与式决策支持框架如何支持选择符合情境且具有社会合法性的NbS以推进LDN，推动了NbS和LDN研究的发展。

title: The Value of Communication for Mental Health
title_zh: 沟通对心理健康的价值
title_primary: 沟通对心理健康的价值
title_secondary: The Value of Communication for Mental Health
authors: Francis Annan, Belinda Archibong
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Mental health disorders account for a significant share of the overall global disease burden. The economic losses from such disorders are staggeringly large, particularly in low-income countries, where people are faced with several unexpected shocks. We test whether improved communication can mitigate such mental health disorders. Partnering with a major telecommunications company, we implement low-cost communication interventions that provide mobile calling credits to a nationally representative set of low-income adults in Ghana during the COVID-19 pandemic. Individuals’ inability to make unexpected calls, need to borrow SOS airtime, and to seek digital loans decreased significantly relative to a control group. As a result, the programs led to a significant decrease in mental distress (-9.7%), the likelihood of severe mental distress by -2.3 percentage points (a quarter of the mean prevalence), and domestic violence, with null impact on overall consumption expenditure. The effects are stronger for monthly mobile credits than a lump-sum. We present evidence that improvements in both business-related services and social inclusion and/or protection are relevant explanations. Simple cost-benefit analysis shows that providing communication credit to low-income adults is a cost-effective policy for improving mental health. Communication – the ability to stay connected – meaningfully improves mental well-being and interventions about communication are particularly valuable when implemented as many installments.
abstract_zh: 心理健康障碍在全球疾病总负担中占据显著比例。此类障碍造成的经济损失极为巨大，尤其在低收入国家，民众常面临多重突发冲击。本研究检验了改善通信条件能否缓解此类心理健康障碍。我们与一家大型电信公司合作，在新冠疫情期间向加纳具有全国代表性的低收入成年人群体实施低成本通信干预措施，即提供手机通话信用额度。相较于对照组，干预对象在无法进行紧急通话、需要借用应急通话时长以及寻求数字贷款等方面的状况显著减少。由此，这些干预措施显著降低了心理困扰程度（-9.7%），使严重心理困扰的发生概率下降2.3个百分点（相当于平均患病率的四分之一），并减少了家庭暴力现象，但对总体消费支出无显著影响。按月发放手机信用额度的效果优于一次性发放。我们提供的证据表明，商业相关服务的改善以及社会包容和/或保护机制的增强是合理的解释路径。简单的成本效益分析显示，向低收入成年人提供通信信用额度是一项具有成本效益的心理健康改善政策。通信——即保持联系的能力——能显著提升心理健康水平，而分多次实施的通信干预措施尤为有价值。

title: Property Rights and Market Frictions: Evidence from the Universe of Land Dispute Files in China
title_zh: 产权与市场摩擦：来自中国土地纠纷档案全集的证据
title_primary: 产权与市场摩擦：来自中国土地纠纷档案全集的证据

authors: Jiong Zhu
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This research demonstrates how securing land property rights can mitigate frictions in rural land rental markets, specifically in the form of landlord-tenant disputes. By combining a comprehensive data set of land rental dispute records, farm-level panel data, and complete agricultural firm registration data, we find that rental disputes decreased following China's land titling reform. We corroborate this finding by distinguishing between property rights-related disputes (e.g., ownership ambiguity, boundary issues, or expropriation) and contractual enforcement disputes (e.g., rent collection). Further analysis reveals that the effect is particularly pronounced in rental agreements between farmers and agricultural firms, especially those involving non-local entities.
abstract_zh: 本研究揭示了保障土地产权如何缓解农村土地租赁市场中的摩擦，具体表现为地主与租户之间的纠纷。通过整合土地租赁纠纷记录的全面数据集、农户层面的面板数据以及完整的农业企业注册数据，我们发现中国的土地确权改革后租赁纠纷有所减少。我们通过区分与产权相关的纠纷（如所有权模糊、边界问题或征收）和合同执行纠纷（如租金收取）来佐证这一发现。进一步分析表明，这一效应在农户与农业企业之间的租赁协议中尤为显著，尤其是涉及非本地实体的协议。

title: The Ripple Effects of China's College Expansion on American Universities

abstract_zh: 中国于1999年实施的前所未有的高等教育扩招政策，使得年度大学招生人数从100万激增至2020年的960万。我们通过考察这一扩招对美国研究生教育及大学城周边地方经济的影响，追溯其全球涟漪效应。结合中国高考录取系统的行政数据与美国签证数据，我们利用中国大学录取的集中配额制度进行识别，并提出三项主要发现。首先，中国本科教育的扩张推动了研究生流向美国：中国每增加100名大学毕业生，便会有3.6名中国研究生赴美深造。其次，中国硕士生带来了正向溢出效应，促进了新硕士项目的诞生，并增加了其他国际及美国本土硕士生的数量。

title: A Model of the Attention Economy: Data, Platforms, and Discovery
title_zh: 注意力经济模型：数据、平台与发现
title_primary: 注意力经济模型：数据、平台与发现
title_secondary: A Model of the Attention Economy: Data, Platforms, and Discovery
authors: Chen, Daniel
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This paper develops a dynamic model of the attention economy featuring two interlinked markets: a product market, where consumers have limited awareness of firms, and an attention market, where platforms attract attention by investing in free services (e.g., social media, streaming, podcasts) and sell targeted ads using data on consumer preferences. The model provides a tractable framework in which platform investment, ad-driven discovery, product demand, and ad revenue are jointly determined. The effects of data and interoperability policies can reverse over time, platform quality may be inefficiently high or low, and the rise of data-rich digital advertising can coincide with a declining ad revenue-to-GDP ratio.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个注意力经济的动态模型，该模型包含两个相互关联的市场：产品市场（消费者对企业的认知有限）和注意力市场（平台通过投资免费服务（如社交媒体、流媒体、播客）吸引注意力，并利用消费者偏好数据销售定向广告）。该模型提供了一个易于处理的框架，其中平台投资、广告驱动的发现、产品需求和广告收入是共同决定的。数据与互操作性政策的效果可能随时间逆转，平台质量可能处于低效的高或低水平，而数据丰富的数字广告的兴起可能与广告收入占GDP比重的下降同时发生。

title: Framing local food and food heritage in European Union food policy
title_zh: 欧盟食品政策中本地食品与食品遗产的框架构建
title_primary: 欧盟食品政策中本地食品与食品遗产的框架构建
title_secondary: Framing local food and food heritage in European Union food policy
authors: Weronika Karsznia, M. Derek, Peter H. Feindt
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The concepts of local food and food heritage have attracted increasing attention in academic and policy debates. Yet, both terms remain ambiguous, contested, and open to multiple interpretations. Within the EU, these notions carry particular importance: food has long been central to EU identity and governance, and current strategies for food system transformation and rural development frequently invoke related terms. While prior work has examined some aspects of the EU food policy framing, no systematic text analysis has specifically examined how the two concepts are being constructed and mobilised within the EUThis study aims to fulfil this gap by exploring how local food and food heritage are conceptualised and operationalised in EU policy documents. It adopts a qualitative research design grounded in a constructionist paradigm. Twelve EU policy documents published between 2011 and 2025 were selected from a broader corpus and analysed using Qualitative Document Analysis (QDA). The codebook was derived from the literature and refined through pilot testing. The findings reveal a shift in the treatment of local food: while earlier and less formal documents refer to it explicitly, more recent, strategic, and legally binding texts rely on indirect framings aligned with food producers’ economic priorities. Food heritage is more consistently present, primarily linked to traditional knowledge and cultural identity. The two concepts intersect most clearly in geographical indications system, and in discourses of local branding and rural development. The analysis demonstrates that EU policies frame local food in line with broader economic objectives, and that food heritage is recognised as part of the EU’s cultural identity and worthy of protection as such. We also conclude that a lack of coherent vision of what is the place of both concepts within the EU food governance risks them being primarily determined by producer competitiveness, thereby causing the relational and cultural dimensions that originally justified these concepts to become marginalised in policy.
abstract_zh: 地方食品与食品遗产的概念在学术与政策讨论中日益受到关注。然而，这两个术语仍存在模糊性、争议性，并具有多重解读空间。在欧盟内部，这些概念尤为重要：食品长期以来一直是欧盟身份认同与治理的核心，而当前食品系统转型与农村发展战略也频繁引用相关术语。尽管已有研究考察了欧盟食品政策框架的某些方面，但尚无系统性文本分析专门探讨这两个概念在欧盟内部如何被构建和动员。本研究旨在填补这一空白，探讨地方食品与食品遗产在欧盟政策文件中的概念化与操作化方式。研究采用基于建构主义范式的定性研究设计，从更广泛的语料库中选取了2011年至2025年间发布的12份欧盟政策文件，并运用定性文件分析（QDA）方法进行分析。编码手册源自文献综述，并通过试点测试加以完善。研究发现，地方食品的处理方式发生了转变：早期且非正式的文件明确提及该概念，而近期、战略性及具有法律约束力的文本则依赖与食品生产者经济优先事项相一致的间接框架。食品遗产则更为持续地出现，主要与传统知识和文化认同相关联。这两个概念在地理标志体系以及地方品牌化和农村发展的话语中交汇最为明显。分析表明，欧盟政策将地方食品置于更广泛的经济目标框架内，而食品遗产则被视为欧盟文化认同的一部分，并因此值得保护。我们还得出结论，欧盟食品治理中对这两个概念定位缺乏统一愿景，可能导致其主要由生产者竞争力所决定，从而使最初赋予这些概念的关系性与文化维度在政策中被边缘化。

title: Colonialism on the Cheap: The French Empire 1830–1962
title_zh: 廉价殖民主义：法兰西帝国（1830–1962）
title_primary: 廉价殖民主义：法兰西帝国（1830–1962）
title_secondary: Colonialism on the Cheap: The French Empire 1830–1962
authors: Denis Cogneau, Yannick Dupraz, Elise Huillery, Sandrine Mesplé-Somps
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How much did France pay for its colonial empire? Did colonies benefit from large transfers from French taxpayers and private investors, or were they, on the contrary, drained of their capital? This paper uses novel budgetary, private investment, and loan data to compute monetary flows between France and the colonies between 1833 and 1962. Public expenditure spent by France on the empire represented only 1.3 percent of its GDP, of which four-fifths was for the military. Trade balance deficits of French colonies were not counterbalanced by large public or private capital transfers from France to the colonies, but by military expenditure from the metropole. Overall, large sums of money were flowing from the colonies to the metropole, a “drain” representing a couple of percentage points of colonial GDP, making French colonies comparable to British India in the twentieth century.
abstract_zh: 法国为其殖民帝国付出了多少代价？殖民地是否从法国纳税人和私人投资者的大规模转移中获益，还是相反，其资本被抽空？本文利用1833年至1962年间法国与殖民地之间新的预算、私人投资和贷款数据，计算了双方的资金流动。法国在帝国上的公共支出仅占其GDP的1.3%，其中五分之四用于军事。法国殖民地的贸易逆差并未通过法国向殖民地的大规模公共或私人资本转移来弥补，而是由宗主国的军事支出所抵消。总体而言，大量资金从殖民地流向宗主国，这种“抽血”相当于殖民地GDP的几个百分点，使得法国殖民地在20世纪与英属印度具有可比性。

title: Agriculture and Natural Disasters: Evidence From the 2015 Nepal Earthquake
title_zh: 农业与自然灾害：来自2015年尼泊尔地震的证据
title_primary: 农业与自然灾害：来自2015年尼泊尔地震的证据
title_secondary: Agriculture and Natural Disasters: Evidence From the 2015 Nepal Earthquake
authors: Rohan Byanjankar
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the short‐ and long‐run effects of the 2015 Nepal Earthquake on paddy production using a difference‐in‐differences framework and district‐level panel data spanning 2010–2019. We document a 10.95% decline in paddy production and a 6.94% decline in yield in earthquake‐affected districts in the short run, with effects fully dissipating over the long run. Decomposing production losses into intensive and extensive margins reveals that the intensive margin explains the majority of losses. Heterogeneity analysis shows that production losses scale with seismic intensity while yield losses operate as a common behavioural shock uniformly across affected districts. Household survey evidence confirms two reinforcing channels: a contraction in agricultural labour supply during the critical planting season and a reallocation of household resources toward reconstruction of damaged dwellings.
abstract_zh: 本文采用双重差分框架及2010–2019年区级面板数据，考察2015年尼泊尔地震对水稻生产的短期与长期影响。研究发现，地震受灾地区的水稻产量在短期内下降10.95%，单产下降6.94%，但长期来看这些影响完全消散。将产量损失分解为集约边际与广延边际后发现，集约边际解释了大部分损失。异质性分析表明，产量损失随地震烈度递增，而单产损失则表现为受灾地区普遍存在的共同行为冲击。家户调查证据证实了两种相互强化的传导渠道：关键播种季节农业劳动力供给的收缩，以及家户资源向受损房屋重建的重新配置。

title: Engine Run, Quality Enhance: Examining the Effects of Energy Steady Supply on Chinese Export Product Quality
title_zh: 引擎运转，质量提升：能源稳定供应对中国出口产品质量的影响研究
title_primary: 引擎运转，质量提升：能源稳定供应对中国出口产品质量的影响研究
title_secondary: Engine Run, Quality Enhance: Examining the Effects of Energy Steady Supply on Chinese Export Product Quality
authors: Yao Hu, Shan Shao, Hui Wang, Weifen Lin
official: 官方在线 2026-07-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Oil is the lifeblood of industry, serving as the core source of power for the operation of industrial machinery. Ensuring its stable supply is crucial for the smooth production process, which in turn is a key determinant in enhancing the quality of export products for enterprises. This study empirically examines the impact of energy supply on the quality of export products and the mechanism of its effect by using a staggered difference‐in‐differences (DID) method with the implementation of China's West‐to‐East Oil Transportation Project as a quasi‐natural experiment. The empirical results show that a dependable energy supply substantially boosts the quality of goods produced for export by various companies. The mechanism analysis shows that energy supply improves export product quality through enterprise performance improvement effects, industry agglomeration effects and supply chain stabilization effects, and it mainly improves export product quality in energy‐importing regions, technology‐intensive industries, private enterprises, and general trade enterprises. Further analysis reveals that a stable supply of energy helps enhance the sustainability of enterprise exports while helping enterprises realize value chain upgrading, helping China get rid of the curse of locking the bottom of the export value chain. The findings of this study help clarify the intrinsic mechanism between energy supply and export product quality and provide an empirical basis for the cross‐regional energy dispatch strategy to help China's export value chain upgrade.
abstract_zh: 摘要 石油是工业的血液，是工业机械运转的核心动力来源。确保其稳定供应对于生产过程的顺利进行至关重要，而这又是提升企业出口产品质量的关键决定因素。本研究以中国“西油东送”工程实施为准自然实验，采用交错双重差分法实证检验了能源供应对出口产品质量的影响及其作用机制。实证结果表明，可靠的能源供应显著提升了各类企业的出口产品质量。机制分析显示，能源供应通过企业绩效提升效应、产业集聚效应和供应链稳定效应改善了出口产品质量，并且主要提升了能源输入地区、技术密集型行业、民营企业和一般贸易企业的出口产品质量。进一步分析发现，稳定的能源供应有助于增强企业出口的可持续性，同时帮助企业实现价值链升级，助力中国摆脱出口价值链低端锁定的困境。本研究结论有助于厘清能源供应与出口产品质量之间的内在机理，并为跨区域能源调度策略助力中国出口价值链升级提供经验依据。

title: Difference-in-differences with unit-specific trends: Bias in post-treatment estimates and a simple alternative
title_zh: 单位特定趋势下的双重差分法：处理后估计的偏差及一个简单替代方案
title_primary: 单位特定趋势下的双重差分法：处理后估计的偏差及一个简单替代方案

authors: Mitch Downey

abstract: Researchers often include unit-specific (e.g., state-specific) trends in difference-in-differences (DiD) specifications. Under standard DiD assumptions, these specifications still yield consistent estimates of dynamic treatment effects (i.e., separate effects for each post-treatment time period) but the pooled post-treatment coefficient is not consistent for the average treatment effect. This single coefficient is a weighted average of the dynamic coefficients, but some weights are often negative. This occurs even without a staggered rollout of treatment. Instead of estimating a pooled coefficient, researchers can estimate the average treatment effect as the mean of the dynamic effects. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
abstract_zh: 研究者常在双重差分（DiD）设定中纳入单位特定（如州特定）趋势。在标准DiD假设下，这些设定仍能得出动态处理效应（即每个处理后期对应的独立效应）的一致估计，但合并处理后期系数并非平均处理效应的一致估计量。该单一系数是动态系数的加权平均值，但部分权重常为负值——即便在非交错式处理推行情况下亦如此。研究者可通过计算动态效应均值来估计平均处理效应，而非采用合并系数。

title: Managing Monetary Policy Normalization
title_zh: 管理货币政策正常化
title_primary: 管理货币政策正常化
title_secondary: Managing Monetary Policy Normalization
authors: Gianluca Benigno, Pierpaolo Benigno
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper develops a framework for monetary policy normalization in which liquidity conditions shape aggregate demand through a liquidity channel. The model implies that central bank balance sheet operations can stabilize demand even away from the zero lower bound, making reserves an independent policy instrument alongside interest rates. Optimal balance sheet size therefore depends not only on private reserve demand, but also on fiscal interactions and liquidity management. Following shocks that generate a liquidity trap, optimal policy expands reserves at the lower bound, initiates quantitative tightening before rate liftoff, and normalizes rates and reserves together, clarifying balance sheets’ stabilization role.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个货币政策正常化框架，其中流动性状况通过流动性渠道影响总需求。模型表明，即使在远离零利率下限的情况下，央行资产负债表操作也能稳定需求，使准备金与利率共同成为独立的政策工具。因此，最优资产负债表规模不仅取决于私人准备金需求，还取决于财政互动与流动性管理。在引发流动性陷阱的冲击发生后，最优政策在零利率下限扩大准备金，在加息启动前实施量化紧缩，并同步推进利率与准备金正常化，从而阐明资产负债表的稳定作用。

abstract: This paper investigates the spatial autoregressive model with convex combination of spatial weights matrices categorized in groups, an empirically relevant specification that has received limited attention in the spatial econometrics literature. We employ the Group Inverse-Gamma Gamma (GIGG) prior introduced by Boss et al. (2024) to distinguish between relevant and irrelevant groups, identify influential spatial weights matrices, and mitigate multicollinearity arising from correlations among matrices within the same group. A computationally efficient Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithm is developed for estimation, inference, and hyperparameter tuning. Simulation studies demonstrate that the proposed prior performs effectively in both parameter estimation and variable selection.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一类具有分组空间权重矩阵凸组合的空间自回归模型，这是一种在空间计量经济学文献中关注有限但具有实证相关性的设定。我们采用Boss等人（2024）提出的组逆伽马-伽马（GIGG）先验，以区分相关组与不相关组，识别具有影响力的空间权重矩阵，并缓解同一组内矩阵间相关性引起的多重共线性问题。我们开发了一种计算高效的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）算法，用于估计、推断及超参数调优。模拟研究表明，所提出的先验在参数估计和变量选择方面均表现出良好的有效性。

title: Unraveling the spatial dynamics and mechanism heterogeneity of land transfer on carbon emission: Evidence from China’s Yangtze River Economic Belt
title_zh: 土地流转对碳排放的空间动态与机制异质性解析：来自中国长江经济带的证据
title_primary: 土地流转对碳排放的空间动态与机制异质性解析：来自中国长江经济带的证据
title_secondary: Unraveling the spatial dynamics and mechanism heterogeneity of land transfer on carbon emission: Evidence from China’s Yangtze River Economic Belt
authors: Chenlu Liu, Chen Zeng, Pengrui Wang, Mingyuan Chang, Xingzi Yu 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In the context of greenhouse gas (GHG) mitigation, effective land management emerges as a paramount policy priority worldwide for carbon mitigation and low-carbon transitions. Using the Yangtze River Economic Belt (YEB) as a case study, this study systematically explores the mechanisms and heterogeneity of land transfer’s impact on carbon emissions, taking spatial spillover effects into account. The findings reveal that: (1) newly allocated built-up land has a markedly stronger effect on carbon emissions compared to the redevelopment of existing land, primarily due to the conversion of agricultural and forest land and the built-up of new infrastructure. (2) In 2015–2022, there is an increase in land transfers for industrial, public service, and transportation purposes at the outskirts, while residential and commercial land allocations have decreased, particularly in the lower reaches of the YEB. (3) Industrial land transfers have the most substantial impact on carbon emissions, while emissions from residential and commercial land can be mitigated through energy-efficient technologies and green building standards. (4) Land transfer area (LTA) is positively correlated with carbon emissions, while land marketization (LM) shows a negative influence. Significant spatial autocorrelation was also observed, underscoring the complex spatial dynamics at play in land use and carbon emissions. Based on the findings, policy recommendations are proposed on differentiated land supply management system, optimizing land marketization process, ecological and environmental standards and guidelines to mitigate carbon emissions through integrated land resource management across regions.
abstract_zh: 在温室气体（GHG）减排背景下，有效的土地管理成为全球范围内实现碳减排和低碳转型的首要政策重点。本研究以长江经济带（YEB）为案例，系统探讨了土地流转对碳排放影响的机制与异质性，并考虑了空间溢出效应。研究发现：（1）新增建设用地对碳排放的影响显著强于存量土地的再开发，主要归因于农用地和林地的转换以及新基础设施的建设。（2）2015—2022年间，郊区工业、公共服务和交通用途的土地流转有所增加，而住宅和商业用地配置减少，尤其在长江经济带下游地区表现明显。（3）工业用地流转对碳排放的影响最为显著，而住宅和商业用地的碳排放可通过节能技术和绿色建筑标准得到缓解。（4）土地流转面积（LTA）与碳排放呈正相关，而土地市场化（LM）则呈现负向影响。同时，研究观察到显著的空间自相关性，凸显了土地利用与碳排放之间复杂的空间动态关系。基于研究结果，提出了差异化土地供应管理体系、优化土地市场化进程、生态与环境标准及指南等政策建议，以通过跨区域土地资源综合管理实现碳减排。

title: To Catch a Thief: Endogenous Policing and Choice of Location by Criminals

abstract: This paper develops a tractable model of offender location choice and police resource allocation across multiple areas. Individuals differ in the cost of apprehension and choose whether to commit crime and, if so, where. Each area contains a fixed value of criminal opportunities, so offenders impose congestion on one another, while policing affects expected apprehension. For arbitrary policing levels, equilibrium sorts offenders by apprehension cost across areas ordered by policing per unit of criminal opportunity value. With a fixed police budget, welfare maximization equalizes policing-to-value ratios across all active areas. The model shows when place-based policing should target the value of criminal opportunities rather than observed crime counts alone, since observed crime may already reflect prior police allocation and offender displacement.

abstract: We consider an oligopoly model in which each firm chooses not only its price but also its advertising strategy regarding how much, and what, product information to provide. To highlight firms' strategic incentives, we impose no structural restrictions on feasible advertising content, so that each firm can disclose or conceal any information. We obtain a comprehensive characterization of the equilibrium advertising strategy and provide some sufficient conditions for the existence of symmetric pure-price equilibria. We show that intense competition induces firms to provide accurate product information; firms usually obfuscate consumers' relatively low or high values; and requiring firms to provide more product information can reduce social surplus and also be harmful to consumers.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个寡头垄断模型，其中每个企业不仅选择其价格，还选择其广告策略，即提供多少以及何种产品信息。为突出企业的策略性激励，我们对可行的广告内容不施加任何结构性限制，因此每个企业可以披露或隐瞒任何信息。我们全面刻画了均衡广告策略的特征，并给出了对称纯价格均衡存在的一些充分条件。研究表明，激烈的竞争会促使企业提供准确的产品信息；企业通常会模糊消费者相对较低或较高的价值；而要求企业提供更多产品信息可能会减少社会剩余，并对消费者造成损害。

abstract: Irrigation is widely recognized as a key driver of agricultural productivity and rural economic development, yet credible evidence on its impacts, mechanisms, and long‐term economic returns remains limited due to endogenous irrigation investments. Leveraging the timing of government irrigation investments and longitudinal household survey data spanning 15 years, we investigate how irrigation affects agricultural productivity. We find that irrigation investment increased the share of irrigated farmland by 11.0 percentage points, which in turn raised per‐area output by 14.9%, net agricultural income by 15.6%, agricultural total factor productivity by 13.7%, and per‐labor output by 36.2%. These effects are driven by four key mechanisms: increased use of high‐productivity inputs, expanded cultivation area, labor reallocation from farm work to off‐farm work, and mitigation of drought damage. The induced land expansion and labor reallocation explain the substantially larger increase in per‐labor output. A cost‐effectiveness analysis suggests a high return to irrigation investment, with approximately half of the return stemming from labor reallocation that increased off‐farm income. These results provide strong evidence that irrigation investment plays an important role in improving agricultural productivity and accelerating rural transformation, with benefits extending beyond the farm by influencing labor markets.
abstract_zh: 灌溉被广泛认为是农业生产力与农村经济发展的关键驱动力，然而由于灌溉投资的内生性问题，关于其影响、机制及长期经济回报的可靠证据仍然有限。利用政府灌溉投资的时机以及跨越15年的纵向农户调查数据，我们研究了灌溉如何影响农业生产力。研究发现，灌溉投资使灌溉农田比例提高了11.0个百分点，进而使单位面积产出增加14.9%，农业净收入增加15.6%，农业全要素生产率提高13.7%，人均产出增加36.2%。这些效应由四个关键机制驱动：高生产率投入品使用增加、种植面积扩大、劳动力从农业向非农就业重新配置，以及干旱损害缓解。土地扩张和劳动力重新配置共同解释了人均产出更大幅度的增长。成本效益分析表明，灌溉投资回报率较高，其中约一半的回报来自劳动力重新配置所增加的非农收入。这些结果有力证明，灌溉投资在提升农业生产力和加速农村转型中发挥重要作用，其效益通过影响劳动力市场而延伸至农业领域之外。

abstract: ABSTRACT Large‐scale solar generation is critical for energy transitions. In Australia, increased solar production to meet emission targets means its land footprint increasingly competes with agricultural land. Understanding the scale and location of agricultural land use change and potential profitability losses from large‐scale solar farms is essential for a sustainable transition, yet comprehensive spatial assessments are lacking. We quantified these potential trade‐offs through spatially explicit modelling of 1568 scenarios that account for a range of uncertainties about utility‐scale solar design, performance, land suitability and energy production targets. Our analysis considered siting strategies that either prioritised the highest solar yield or reduced the land use trade‐off ratio of energy to agricultural profitability. The results show that meeting national utility‐scale solar targets could convert up to 273,000 ha (0.28% of total agricultural land). While a yield‐focused approach could result in annual agricultural profit losses of up to $29 million, adopting an approach that reduced opportunity costs on agricultural production can reduce these losses to $2.6 million for the same energy generation. Even the larger of these two figures represents less than 0.03% of Australia's farm‐gate output. Impacts are primarily concentrated in grazing regions of Queensland, Western Australia and New South Wales. ‘Agrisolar’—co‐location of agriculture or grazing with solar development could help further mitigate agricultural production and regional impacts. These results show that while the overall national impact on agricultural land from large‐scale solar expansion may be marginal, strategic spatial planning and agrisolar (where feasible) are crucial for mitigating adverse regional effects.
abstract_zh: 摘要 大规模太阳能发电对于能源转型至关重要。在澳大利亚，为满足减排目标而增加太阳能产量，意味着其土地足迹日益与农业用地竞争。理解大规模太阳能电站导致的农业用地变化规模、位置及潜在盈利损失，对于实现可持续转型至关重要，然而目前缺乏全面的空间评估。我们通过空间显式建模，对1568种情景进行了量化分析，这些情景涵盖了公用事业规模太阳能设计、性能、土地适宜性和能源生产目标等方面的多种不确定性。我们的分析考虑了两种选址策略：一种优先追求最高太阳能产出，另一种则旨在降低能源与农业盈利之间的土地利用权衡比率。结果显示，满足国家公用事业规模太阳能目标可能需转换高达273,000公顷（占农业总用地的0.28%）的土地。虽然以产出为导向的策略可能导致每年高达2900万美元的农业利润损失，但采用降低农业生产机会成本的策略，在同等能源产出下可将损失降至260万美元。即便这两个数字中较大的一个，也仅占澳大利亚农场门产出总额的不到0.03%。影响主要集中在昆士兰州、西澳大利亚州和新南威尔士州的牧区。“农业光伏”——即农业或牧业与太阳能开发的共址布局，有助于进一步缓解农业生产及区域影响。这些结果表明，尽管大规模太阳能扩张对全国农业用地的总体影响可能有限，但战略性空间规划和农业光伏（在可行情况下）对于缓解不利的区域影响至关重要。

abstract: We propose a global games approach to the standard two-stage entry game. The entry decisions in the first stage are strategic substitutes. The second-stage game of product market competition reflects a fundamental common value “market attractiveness” parameter, about which firms get private noisy signals. The main result establishes the selection of a unique equilibrium in the entry game, as noise vanishes, in cut-off strategies implying efficient entry. This provides a theoretical foundation for the equilibrium selection commonly used in entry models in the empirical literature. In addition, using supermodularity techniques, we provide novel conditions of independent interest on the primitives (demand and cost functions) of market competition to justify our assumptions for Bertrand and Cournot competition. These include results on the effects of entry and demand shifts and highlight the critical relevance of the property of log-supermodularity of demand.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种全局博弈方法，用于分析标准的两阶段进入博弈。第一阶段中的进入决策表现为策略性替代关系。第二阶段的商品市场竞争博弈反映了一个基本的共同价值参数——“市场吸引力”，企业对此获得私人的噪声信号。主要结果确立了在噪声消失时，进入博弈中唯一均衡的选择，该均衡采用阈值策略，意味着有效率的进入。这为实证文献中常用的进入模型均衡选择提供了理论基础。此外，利用超模性技术，我们提供了关于市场竞争原始要素（需求与成本函数）的新颖条件，这些条件具有独立意义，用以证明伯特兰和古诺竞争假设的合理性。这些条件包括进入和需求变动效应的结果，并强调了需求对数超模性这一性质的关键重要性。

abstract: How do regional comparative advantages influence the long-term effects of government interventions? This paper explores this question using disaggregated data on factor endowments and industrial construction in China under the centrally planned economic system during 1953–1978. These investment decisions, primarily driven by political considerations, led to significant variations in the congruence between the factor intensity of policy-targeted industries and local endowment structure. Our findings show that while government interventions can have positive and lasting impacts on the size and efficiency of local industries, misalignments between the production technology of targeted industries and the factor endowment structure significantly weaken these effects.

abstract: We investigate how Reconstruction affected Black socio‐economic advancement after the American Civil War. We use the location of federal troops and Freedmen's bureau offices to indicate more intensive federal enforcement of civil rights. We find that Black people made greater socio‐economic advances where Reconstruction was more rigorously enforced, and that these effects persisted at least until the early twentieth century, although these advances were weaker in cotton‐plantation zones. We suggest a mechanism leading from greater Black political power to higher local property taxes through to higher levels of Black schooling and greater Black socio‐economic achievement.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了美国内战后重建对黑人社会经济进步的影响。我们利用联邦军队驻扎地点和自由民局办公室的位置作为联邦民权执法力度的指标。研究发现，在重建执行更为严格的地区，黑人取得了更大的社会经济进步，且这些影响至少持续至二十世纪初，尽管在棉花种植园区这些进步相对较弱。我们提出一个机制：黑人政治权力的增强导致地方财产税提高，进而促进黑人教育水平提升及社会经济成就的增长。
